name: Account record: UID, resources
notes: Runs last. Several accounts are told apart by the UID on the account info page; each gets its own record (accounts/<uid>.json in the data directory: the GUI's profile folder, or local-data/ for the CLI; never in the repository).
Credits, pyroxene and AP are read from the top bar with OCR and appended to the record's history.
The nickname and level sit in the panel at the bottom left. The GUI shows one box per record on the My info tab.
